description: Operations dashboard for the claudeai-api service (Go).

panels.title: Claude success ratio
panels.description: Share of Claude runs that finished with outcome success over the selected time range.

panels.title: Claude runs in flight
panels.description: Claude CLI processes running right now (callers waiting for a concurrency slot are not counted).

panels.title: Skills loaded
panels.description: Skills in the current snapshot of the skills repository (0 or no data when skills are disabled).

panels.title: Claude runs / sec by outcome
panels.description: Finished Claude CLI runs per second, stacked by outcome.

panels.title: Claude success ratio (5m)
panels.description: Share of runs that finished with outcome success over the last 5 minutes; red below 90%, yellow below 99%.

panels.title: Claude errors by outcome
panels.description: Non-success Claude runs per outcome over the selected time range.

panels.title: Claude run duration
panels.description: Whole-call duration (including the wait for a concurrency slot) at p50, p95 and p99.

panels.title: Claude time to first token
panels.description: Time from the start of the call to the first text delta (includes queue wait; a skill tool call adds a model turn) at p50 and p95.

panels.title: Claude queue wait p95 and runs in flight
panels.description: p95 wait for a concurrency slot (left axis) next to the CLI processes running now (right axis); a rising wait with in flight at the limit means -claude-max-concurrency is saturated.

panels.title: Tokens / sec by type
panels.description: Tokens reported by the CLI per second, stacked by type (input, output, cache_creation, cache_read).

panels.title: Estimated cost (last 24h)
panels.description: Cost over the last 24 hours as estimated by the Claude CLI at list prices; it is an estimate, not billing.

panels.title: Cache hit ratio
panels.description: cache_read tokens divided by all prompt-side tokens (input + cache_creation + cache_read) over the selected time range.

panels.title: Estimated cost per hour by model
panels.description: Estimated USD per hour (rate times 3600) by model, from the CLI's own cost estimate, not billing.

panels.title: Average prompt tokens per run
panels.description: Prompt-side tokens (input + cache_creation + cache_read) per run; the CLI sums every turn, so runs that use a skill count more than the final prompt, and failed runs without tokens dilute the average.

panels.title: Skills loaded
panels.description: Skills in the current snapshot of the skills repository.

panels.title: Seconds since last successful sync
panels.description: Age of the last successful skills sync; yellow above 900 s and red above 3600 s, fixed values that assume the default -skills-refresh of 5 minutes (adjust if you refresh less often).

panels.title: Consecutive sync failures
panels.description: Skills syncs that failed in a row (0 after a success); red as soon as there is one.

panels.title: Current skills version
panels.description: Commit (12 characters) and ref of the skills snapshot currently in use.

panels.title: Skills sync outcomes / sec
panels.description: Skills repository syncs per second by outcome (success: new version, noop: already current, error).

panels.title: Skills sync duration p95
panels.description: p95 duration of a skills repository sync (git fetch or clone plus materialization).

panels.title: Skill invocations
panels.description: Skill tool uses by skill name over the selected time range (names outside the loaded snapshot are reported as other).

title: claudeai-api - Operations Overview
